sm_top.sm: The UK is addressing hybrid threats, including cyberattacks and terror plots linked to Iran and Russia.
Multiple tankers and merchant vessels were attacked and struck by projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz.
Yemeni government forces launched an offensive and made advances against Houthi forces across multiple fronts including Taiz and Bab al-Mandeb.
The Saudi-led coalition reports destroying two ballistic missiles launched by the Houthis toward Khamis Mushait and north of Riyadh.
A Hamas field commander was killed in an Israeli UAV strike near Shifa Hospital in Gaza City.
Airstrikes and shelling hit Houthi targets in Sanaa amid ongoing military operations.
Rybar claims Russian forces launched a massive overnight missile and drone strike targeting military-industrial and energy infrastructure across multiple Ukrainian regions.
Saudi Ministry of Defense reports the interception of 5 ballistic missiles, 7 drones, and 1 cruise missile.
President Zelenskyy reported that two Russian drones struck a Turkish-owned civilian cargo vessel in neutral waters, killing the captain and injuring another crew member.
Houthi forces launched missile and drone attacks targeting Yemen's Aden airport.
A US military strike on a drug-smuggling boat in the Caribbean left four people dead.
Russia claims Ukraine launched 1,750 drones and 17 Flamingo missiles in its biggest strike of the war.
Clashes and shelling were reported across Taiz Governorate amid Houthi advances and government counteroffensives.
Yemeni forces launched a military operation to retake territory held by the Houthis.
Crew members are missing after drone attacks hit two commercial vessels in the Black Sea near Bulgaria.
Houthis report that Saudi forces launched 94 air strikes across Yemen over a 24-hour period.
A missile was launched toward the Strait of Hormuz.
Houthi-aligned media reports a new missile launch toward the Saudi interior.
Russia launched over 200 missiles at Ukraine, including North Korean KN-23 ballistic missiles.
A drone sank a ship off the coast of Bulgaria amid growing concerns over hybrid attacks.
Houthi-aligned channel reports two missiles were launched from Sirik toward the Strait of Hormuz.
Mali troops entered the strategic northern town of Kidal after separatist fighters withdrew.
Ukrainian air defenses intercept or suppress 114 out of 137 incoming Russian attack drones.
Saudi Arabia claims intercepting a Houthi drone near Mecca, which the Houthis deny.
Houthi-aligned media claim a cruise missile targeted a ship near the coast of Qatar, causing a fire.
Eritrean troops have deployed into Ethiopia's Tigray region.
Israel raised its military alert level amid reports detecting threats ahead of the October 7 anniversary.
Ukraine launches nearly 900 drones at Russia as Kyiv braces for an expected massive aerial assault.
The USS Abraham Lincoln carrier strike group returned to San Diego after completing its deployment.
NPR reports Saudi Arabia launched a new military offensive against the Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen.
Reports indicate U.S. President Trump is weighing a potential military strike against Iran before the midterms.
Drones hit two ships 80 nautical miles off the Bulgarian coast.
The United States announced plans to send more troops to Israel.
A Ukrainian drone attack set fire to an oil tanker carrying 23 Indian crew members.
The UN reports that fighting escalation in Yemen has displaced more than 200,000 people.
Reports indicated Houthi strikes on Saudi airports as fighting intensified around Bab el-Mandeb.
Ukrainian President Zelenskyy states that intelligence suggests Russia is preparing for a large-scale attack.
Battlefield gains against Houthis expose rifts among Yemen's anti-Houthi forces.
Russian MoD claims air defense forces intercepted 59 Ukrainian fixed-wing drones over several regions and the Black Sea between 08:00 and 20:00 Moscow time.
Sudan's al-Burhan rejected talks as clashes widened, with at least 10 civilians killed in West Kordofan and 5,500 displaced in Blue Nile.
